Subject: Acme Corp — SOC 2 & Security Recap / Next Steps

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of pain, goals, and next steps:

Pain points discussed:
- Need for SOC 2 Type II evidence and ongoing attestation
- Audit log retention and export for security audits (90–365 days depending on record)
- Data retention policy and DPA terms (data residency, deletion upon request)
- Pen test evidence and hardening posture for inference hosts
- Encryption & key management (KMS/HSM) and access controls

Goals:
- Validate Redwood's controls for Acme's procurement & security workflows
- Define what artifacts Acme needs to sign off (SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, retention docs, DPA)
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with Infra/Security to walk architecture and logging

Next steps (owners + timeline):
1) I'll share SOC 2 summary + redacted report and our compliance portal link — by EOD today (attachments)
2) Rishi will own technical deep dive and bring infra diagrams + log retention tables — propose dates Wed 10/28 or Thu 10/29
3) Please share your DPA redlines; we'll circulate a redlined template for legal review
4) If there are any specific questionnaire items, list them and we'll prioritize

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_summary.pdf (summary)
- SOC2-AT-2025-Report.pdf (redacted)

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — this is great context.

A few clarifying items for our security/compliance team:
- Can you confirm default audit log retention windows and whether logs can be exported to our S3? We typically keep logs for 12 months.
- For encryption: are customer keys supported via dedicated KMS/HSM or BYOK? Any limitations for private deployments?
- Do you have a short pen-test evidence packet (summary of findings + remediation timeline) we can share during our internal review?
- For the DPA: we'll send initial redlines, but we'd like to review a redlined template if you have one.

Also — can you confirm availability for a security deep dive next week? Wed/Thu mornings PT work for us.

-Jared

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp — SOC 2 & Security Recap / Next Steps

Jared — thanks, noted. Attaching the artifacts we discussed and inline answers below.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf (summary & remediation status)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (sample export format)
- DPA-template-redlined.docx (our standard DPA; legal will accept reasonable redlines)

Quick answers:
- Audit logs: default retention is 90 days for hosted plans; Dedicated/Private customers can configure up to 24 months. We support periodic exports to S3 buckets (CSV/JSON) and syslog forwarding.
- Encryption/KMS: Hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS by default. We support BYOK via customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments; HSM integrations are available for enterprise via our Private offering.
- Pen test evidence: attached summary includes scope & remediation. For full reports we can provide redacted copies under NDA if needed.
- DPA: attached our template — happy to review your redlines. We can route to legal after initial alignment.

Proposed security deep dive: Wed, Oct 28, 2026 10:00 AM PT — Rishi (security/infra) + Dev (platform) will join. Please confirm or propose an alternate slot.

Next actions:
- Marissa: Share these artifacts (done)
- Rishi: Prepare infra diagram, retention & export matrix, and runbook (will share before the deep dive)
- Acme: Send DPA redlines + any specific questionnaire items

Thanks,
Marissa

--
